verdict.rationale: Cekura is an evaluation and observability platform for voice agents, so human annotation queues are a fair question for it. The evidence documents only automated evaluation: LLM-judge metrics, Python metrics, rubrics, sampling and drift detection. Nothing shows routing calls or outputs to human reviewers or labeling queues, and automated judging and sampling do not stand in for human annotation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
